description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two Text-to-SQL models — NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue) — across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents “Execution Accuracy” ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For the “Simple” category, NatSQL achieves 60.21% accuracy while TA-SQL reaches 63.14%. In the “Moderate” category, NatSQL scores 39.64% and TA-SQL 48.60%. For “Challenging” queries, NatSQL attains 32.32% and TA-SQL 36.11%. The “Total” accuracy across all categories shows NatSQL at 51.35% and TA-SQL at 56.19%. Across all difficulty levels, TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL, with the largest gap observed in the Moderate category (8.96 percentage points) and the smallest in the Challenging category (3.79 percentage points). The chart visually emphasizes TA-SQL’s superior performance through taller dark blue bars in every category, supporting the paper’s claim that its alignment strategy effectively mitigates hallucinations in SQL generation.
